PC Errata 2022 disc card of [[Rayc Ryjerd]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 2 August 2022. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/JabbasPalace-Light/large/raycryjerd.gif raycryjerd.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220802095009/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/JabbasPalace-Light/large/raycryjerd.gif Internet Archive] (2 August 2022, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 31 July 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260731134407/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/JabbasPalace-Light/large/raycryjerd.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Rayc Ryjerd (PC Errata 2022 disc card)]].
